title: A JAGGED WHITE BOLT FROM THE SKY TO EACH LIGHTNING STRIKE
why: His order 10-28: when the lightning hits, along with the flash, it would be cool to have a white jagged line lightning graphic extend from the top of the screen down to the hit location, so it looks like sky-to-ground lightning. A strike showed only the flash sheet and the warning ring.
now: Each lightning strike that lands on screen draws a white jagged bolt with two or three side forks from the top edge of the view down to the strike point, brightest at the ground, with a quick double flicker, gone in about a third of a second with the flash. Render only: where strikes land and what they hit are unchanged, and the shape uses no game random number. Effects reduced: no bolt.
